notes.title: Sin Slayers is Now Steam Deck Verified + Hotfix#2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893926/77b7fe9913b1a24e1a06a2eb6f557b05e87c8f9e.png

We’re excited to announce that Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th is now Steam Deck Verified!

Enjoy the full game experience seamlessly on your Steam Deck with optimized controls, great performance, and flawless compatibility. 

Dive into the dark fantasy world wherever you go!

Patch Notes for Hotfix #2:

Fixes and Improvements:


 Community Localization: Fixed various text errors in character skill descriptions provided by community localizations.
 UI Adjustment: Resolved the issue where the "Close" button text was not visible in the party management window.
 Gameplay Mechanics: Targets marked with Mark of Hunter can no longer evade attacks.
 Resolution Limitation: Disabled support for resolutions higher than 1920x1200 to ensure better performance and stability.


We deeply appreciate your continued support! If you enjoy the game, we’d be incredibly grateful if you could take a moment to leave a review on Steam. Your feedback means the world to us and helps us improve the experience for everyone.

Stay tuned for further news and activities by following Twitter and joining the Discord server of Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th 

As always, we love ya, Slayers! ❤️ 

Goonswarm Team

notes.title: Autumn Sale & Hotfix
notes.notes:
Greetings, Slayers! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893926/464e0b6320557e79c2e5ee43cf651c4111415156.png

We can’t thank you enough for your incredible support for Sin Slayers! 
Your love for the game has been truly inspiring, and we’re thrilled to share some exciting news:

Sin Slayers is part of the Autumn Sale, and we’re extending the 40% discount for the entire duration of the sale! That’s right, you’ve got even more time to grab the game and dive into the darkness with your party of sinners.

But that’s not all! We’ve also released an update addressing some important fixes:

 Resolved an issue where letters in a single word appeared in different sizes (Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Czech, and Turkish).
 Fixed localization errors in Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, and Turkish.
 Corrected text alignment issues that caused button text to split into two lines in certain languages.Your feedback and support mean the world to us, and it’s what keeps us going! 

Don’t miss this chance to grab Sin Slayers during the sale - our adventure awaits! 💀✨
Grab your copy for yourself or a copy for a friend of yours, makes the best early Christmas gift!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790000/Sin_Slayers_Reign_of_The_8th/

Stay tuned for further news and activities by following Twitter and joining the Discord server of Sin Slayers: Reign of the 8th 🔥

We hope you enjoy the game, explore its dark fantasy world, and uncover all the sins waiting for you.

Thank you SO MUCH for your continued support! As always, we love ya, Slayers! ❤️ 

Goonswarm Team
